Multi-Tusking is a removed older mission with Boargar tusks. Its item/drop/reward rules must not be used as an analogue for Forming Alliances.

Mission-conditional drops are implemented in source through ItemCollected binding creature_id and drop_chance. The chosen chance and template are labelled in wilderness-forming-alliances-reconstruction.json and need original-client comparison.

Whether Apirka consumed the twelve hearts at turn-in, the exact drop chance, and whether already owned hearts count are not captured. The source uses an explicitly inferred consume-on-turn-in rule; keep it under review.

The reconstructed vest has the closest original class and observed armor value but lacks its Luminar naming/effect tuple and the observed regen and Laser-resistance effects. Restore these when evidence or a bounded estimate supports them.
